prompt_fragment: This asset is a card face. Compose for a vertical 3:4 frame with a strong focal subject and room for card framing or overlay treatment.
raw_description:
Upper half: a Shadow Parliament gathering in a fire-core-lit cave-chamber
beneath the permanent ice shelf. Three hooded figures stand around a
stone table; bioluminescent ice glyphs pulse cold blue-green along the
walls. A tattered faction banner with a ☽-marked sigil hangs behind them.
Smoke from venting picks curls upward. Conspiracy and rank, not ceremony.
Lower half: warm dark surface for overlaid text, ghosted banner
watermark. Warm cream parchment frame.
formatted_prompt: Editorial ink-and-watercolor illustration, richly pigmented, vertical 3:4 card-face composition. Three adult emperor penguins in charcoal-grey hooded robes gather around a rough stone table in a fire-core-lit cavern beneath glacial ice. Each figure wears volcanic-glass-and-blackened-sinew armor with ember-thread embroidery casting faint orange glow at the hems; bone-and-volcanic-glass masks obscure narrow beaks, small dark eyes catching firelight. Bioluminescent ice glyphs pulse cold cyan along curved tunnel walls. A tattered crimson-and-charcoal banner bearing a ☽ moon-truncation sigil hangs behind them, edges frayed. Venting-pick smoke curls upward into blue-dark ice ceiling. Braziers burn vivid ember-orange, separating warm foreground from cold glowing midground. Lower third fades to warm ochre-parchment shadow for text overlay, ghosted sigil watermark beneath. Deep obsidian blacks, saturated ember-orange, luminous cyan-green bioluminescence, aged-cream frame border. Conspiratorial stillness, not ceremony.
